The most common yellow fruit that monkeys also eat is the banana.

The central conflict in the text is an ethical dilemma faced by Captain Reyes and her crew. They must choose between adhering to the Prime Directive, which prohibits interfering with undeveloped civilizations, and acting to save an alien species whose planet is facing destruction. This creates an internal struggle between the moral imperative to help those in distress and the potential negative ramifications of violating established interstellar laws.
